title: Smoke Test — Event Reconciliation widget (post transaction_type/payment_method split)
subtitle: Re-validates the dashboard reconciliation widget now that order_payments stores transaction_type (PAYMENT/DONATION/COMP/WRITE_OFF) and payment_method (CASH/CHECK/CREDIT_CARD/BANK_TRANSFER) as two orthogonal columns instead of the old overloaded type.

meta.Flow: Login → event 327 dashboard → Event Reconciliation widget → edit + save a channel fee
meta.Schema change: order_payments.type → transaction_type + payment_method; orders.offline_payment_* and order_payment_adjustments dropped (all confirmed live)
meta.Event: 327 (smoke:reversal-fixture) enriched with a 7-order multi-channel ledger that exercises every transaction_type x payment_method axis

steps.title: Dashboard loads
steps.description: Event dashboard top — existing stat boxes and charts unaffected; the Event Reconciliation widget is appended below.

steps.title: Event Reconciliation card — waterfall ties out
steps.description: Three headline tiles (Net expected funds $446.57, Collected to date $420.00 with a 94% progress bar, Net to bank $420.00) and the waterfall: Gross $476.57 − Refunds $20.00 − Comps (forgiven) $35.00 + Donations $25.00 = Net expected $446.57.
steps.notes: The $35.00 'Comps (forgiven)' line merges the COMP ($25) and WRITE_OFF ($10) transaction_types — both settle without money. Gross is $476.57 = the seeded $475 plus the fixture's untouched $1.57 awaiting-payment order. Backend service output matches this card exactly.

steps.title: Funds by Channel — payment_method drives the channel
steps.description: Per-channel rows derived purely from the ledger's new columns: CREDIT_CARD→Square ($100 sales + $10 donation, −$20 refund), CASH→Cash ($50 + $15 donation), CHECK→Check ($40), BANK_TRANSFER→Bank transfer ($25); Stripe ($200) comes from stripe_payments, not the ledger. Totals reconcile to $415 sales / $25 donations / −$20 refunds / $420 net deposit / 100%.
steps.notes: Validates the split end to end: PAYMENT rows → sales, DONATION rows → donations, COMP+WRITE_OFF → the 'Non-cash credits' footer ($25.00 comps · $10.00 write-offs, no money in the door). The $20 refund attributes to Square — the channel of the order's largest settling CREDIT_CARD payment. Cash & Check fee inputs are disabled (no processing fee); Stripe, Square and Bank transfer are editable.

steps.title: Edit a channel fee (dirty state)
steps.description: Setting the Stripe fee from $0.00 to $7.50 enables the 'Save fees' button.

steps.title: Save fee — persisted, recorded & recomputed
steps.description: Save fires the PATCH and recomputes: Stripe net deposit $200 → $192.50, the waterfall's Processing fees line → −$7.50, Net to bank (est.) → $412.50, Totals fee → $7.50. Footer stamps 'Fees updated May 31, 2026' and the Save button returns to disabled.
steps.notes: DB confirms the round-trip: event_channel_fees upserted all five channels, STRIPE fee_amount=7.50, recorded_by_user_id=545. Full edit → persist → reconcile → re-render cycle works on the new schema.
